It is generally not advisable to hide information from your teachers or professors. It is important to be honest and forthright with your teachers and to always strive to do your best work. If you have a legitimate reason why you can't complete an assignment, you should discuss it with your teacher and explain why.

BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why are we so terrified of making mistakes if we can learn from them and improve? ASSISTANT:

erhaps we are afraid of making mistakes because they can feel embarrassing, cost us time and energy, and seem to lead to negative consequences. But mistakes can also be a source of learning and personal growth, and ultimately help us become better and stronger.
